Emily (CSM): Heads up — VeloraMed asked for SLO alignment before their renewal call next Tue. They want 99.95% uptime and p95 < 200ms. Also asked how credits would be calculated for latency breaches.
Sam (AE): Are they on Dedicated or Hosted?
Emily (CSM): Hosted (standard). Volume ~2M tokens/day, mostly us-west.
Nora (Onboarding): We flipped prefix caching and warm pools last week — our current p95 baseline for their tenant in us-west is ~180ms. I can pull the week-over-week numbers.
Emily (CSM): They requested weekly reporting for the first 60 days, then monthly thereafter. Can we commit to weekly PDF decks for that period?
Mike (SRE): Weekly is fine. For clarity on credits: our standard uptime SLA = 99.9% with credit calc = (99.9% - observed) / 99.9% * monthly fee, capped at 30%. Latency credits are not automatic in standard T&Cs. If they want latency credits we need an addendum.
Emily (CSM): OK — they specifically asked for a latency-based credit trigger. Can you propose language?
Mike (SRE): Draft proposal (brief): "If p95 latency exceeds 250ms for two consecutive weeks, Redwood will issue a credit equal to 5% of the monthly invoice for each full percentage point above the threshold, capped at 20% per month."
Mike (SRE): Example calc snippet I can include in the addendum:
```
uptime_slo = 0.999
observed = 0.997
credit_pct = min(((uptime_slo - observed) / uptime_slo) * 100, 30)
```
Nora (Onboarding): I'll own the weekly deck for the 60-day window. Emily — can you share the customer's reporting fields (they asked for uptime, p95, p99, error-rate, and 3 sample traces)?
Emily (CSM): Will DM the engineering contact now and ask for preferred time window + timezones.
report-bot: uploaded veloramed-week1-slo.csv to #shared-reports (link: https://files.redwood/veloramed-week1-slo.csv)
Emily (CSM): Thanks all. Action items: Mike to draft addendum wording and example credit table; Nora to prepare week 1 deck; Emily to confirm customer fields and cadence. I'll loop back by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
